# LumePane

> LumePane is a native macOS 14+ console for display control, mouse-wheel smoothing, window layouts and a draggable Glow Orb dock. 14-day fully featured trial; one-time purchase; no account; no telemetry.

Canonical: https://lumepane.com/
Source / releases: https://github.com/huayanming/displaypilot
Free browser tools:
- Wheel smoothness test: https://lumepane.com/scroll-test.html
- Display test patterns: https://lumepane.com/display-test.html
- Window layout preview: https://lumepane.com/window-layouts.html
- Open-source wheel test: https://github.com/huayanming/lumepane-scroll-test
Pricing: one-time, approximately US$19 / ¥99; 14-day trial; no subscription.
Limitations: macOS exposes no public Apple Watch battery API; some third-party mice do not expose battery; trackpad gestures remain native.
Press kit: https://lumepane.com/press.html
Verification: https://lumepane.com/verify.html
